publishingInformation.testingInstructions: No account linking or purchases. Say 'Alexa, open smart answers' (es-US/es-ES: 'Alexa, abre consulta inteligente'), then ask any general question, for example 'who wrote Don Quixote'. The skill answers by voice and asks if you want another question; say no to exit. Answers come from a generative AI model and need internet access.
